Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City and County of San Francisco, April 2, 1925
sources.label: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, San Francisco Public Library (Internet Archive)

historical_record.description: The Board of Park Commissioners awarded Elliot & Grant, the low bidder at $11,798, the contract to build a club house at the baseball field in Golden Gate Park.
